name: π₀.₅ base
license_note: Apache 2.0 checkpoint. PaliGemma weights inside it follow the Gemma license.
notes: LeRobot conversion of the π₀.₅ base policy. Same PaliGemma init as π₀. π₀.₅ feeds discretized state as text and puts adaRMS on the action expert only (use_adarms=[False, True]); the VLM stack is still the pt-224 PaliGemma. There is no released π₀.₅-FAST base checkpoint.
convention: lm-evaluation-harness arc_easy, 0-shot: raw 'Question: {question}\nAnswer:' and each choice text as a continuation; argmax of summed log-probability (acc) and of log-probability per character (acc_norm)

vocab: lm_head.weight: copied 257152, masked 64 logits the VLA has no rows for
model.language_model.embed_tokens.weight: copied 257152, kept the baseline's 64 trailing rows
